reviews.title: Good, Stable kit of memory for Ryzen 5600
reviews.comment: I had some issues with my previous 16gb kit from Neo Forza and wanted to upgrade to 32gb - this kit was a really good price, and I had no issues at all getting this to run at its rated speed. It's been rock-solid stable with no memory errors since I've installed it
reviews.author: Kameka smith

reviews.title: Perfect for SFF builds
reviews.comment: Ram fits great, just barely fits under the cpu cooler i put in the sff build i took to college.  Its been super stable at the 3600mhz as well.
reviews.author: Alex

reviews.title: works as advertised
reviews.comment: bought to pair with my 'new' 13700kf and returned my 2400mhz 2x8 to its htpc home, making a significant improvement in performance to my system. no more weird lagging opening programs or files. everything is very snappy even with the underclock at 4.6 (the i7 runs a little warm at stock even with a 260w cooler). not sure why it crashed when xmp was enabled, probably just needs some tweaking. but again, its a welcome improvement without xmp. good purchase. thanks (htpc came with 1 stick of 8gb. it was somewhat cheaper to buy 3 matching sticks than all new ram and have a spare. capacity was of greater concern than speed for the i5 7600 machine since it sometimes doubles as a home server for games)
reviews.author: Kory

reviews.title: Installed with ease and its used with a matching set already installed
reviews.comment: Price was right.... Installed in a computer that already had 16 Meg and this is identical to those already installed. Work great... no problems
